017package org.apache.juneau.server.config.rest;
018
019import java.io.*;
020import java.net.*;
021import java.nio.charset.*;
022import java.security.*;
023
024import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
025
026import org.apache.juneau.config.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.http.response.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.*;
029import org.apache.juneau.rest.server.guard.*;
030
031/**
032 * Guard that protects {@link LoadConfigResource} with a shared API key.
033 *
034 * <p>
035 * The expected key is read from the <c>[Security]</c> section of <c>juneau-server-config.cfg</c>:
036 * <p class='bini'>
037 *    <cs>[Security]</cs>
038 *    <ck>apiKey</ck> = <cv>some-long-random-secret</cv>
039 * </p>
040 *
041 * <p>
042 * Clients supply the key in either an <c>Authorization: Bearer &lt;key&gt;</c> header or an <c>X-Api-Key</c> header.
043 * The comparison is constant-time ({@link MessageDigest#isEqual(byte[], byte[])} over UTF-8 bytes).
044 *
045 * <p>
046 * The key is read once, when the guard is created, and the {@link Config} used to read it is closed straight away.
047 * Changing the key requires a restart.
048 *
049 * <p>
050 * Requests that did not arrive over a secure channel are refused unless they come from a loopback address or
051 * <c>[Security]</c> <ck>allowInsecure</ck> is <cv>true</cv>.
052 * A loopback peer is only exempt when the request carries no <c>Forwarded</c> or <c>X-Forwarded-*</c> header,
053 * since a local reverse proxy would otherwise make remote plain-HTTP traffic look local.
054 *
055 * <p>
056 * The guard <b>fails closed</b>: if no key is configured (missing, empty or unreadable setting), every request is
057 * rejected with a 403.  The key is never logged or echoed.  Always use TLS.
058 */
059public class ConfigApiKeyGuard extends RestGuard {
060
061   private static final String CONFIG_NAME = "juneau-server-config.cfg";
062   private static final String CONFIG_KEY = "Security/apiKey";
063   private static final String ALLOW_INSECURE_KEY = "Security/allowInsecure";
064   private static final String BEARER = "Bearer ";
065
066   private final String key;
067   private final boolean allowInsecure;
068
069   /** Constructor.  Reads the settings once and releases the configuration. */
070   public ConfigApiKeyGuard() {
071      String k = null;
072      var insecure = false;
073      try {
074         var c = Config.create().name(CONFIG_NAME).build();
075         try {
076            k = c.get(CONFIG_KEY).orElse(null);
077            insecure = c.get(ALLOW_INSECURE_KEY).asBoolean().orElse(false);
078         } finally {
079            c.close();
080         }
081      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") Exception e) {
082         // Fail closed; deliberately do not log (avoid leaking config content).
083      }
084      key = k;
085      allowInsecure = insecure;
086   }
087
088   @Override /* Overridden from RestGuard */
089   public boolean guard(RestRequest req, RestResponse res) throws BasicHttpException {
090      if (! isRequestAllowed(req))
091         throw new Forbidden("Access denied.");
092      return true;
093   }
094
095   @Override /* Overridden from RestGuard */
096   public boolean isRequestAllowed(RestRequest req) {
097      var r = req.getHttpServletRequest();
098      if (! isChannelAcceptable(r.isSecure(), r.getRemoteAddr(), allowInsecure, isForwarded(r)))
099         return false;
100      return isAuthorized(configuredKey(), req.getHeader("Authorization"), req.getHeader("X-Api-Key"));
101   }
102
103   private static boolean isForwarded(HttpServletRequest r) {
104      if (r.getHeader("Forwarded") != null)
105         return true;
106      var names = r.getHeaderNames();
107      while (names != null && names.hasMoreElements())
108         if (names.nextElement().regionMatches(true, 0, "X-Forwarded-", 0, 12))
109            return true;
110      return false;
111   }
112
113   static boolean isChannelAcceptable(boolean secure, String remoteAddr, boolean allowInsecure, boolean forwarded) {
114      if (secure || allowInsecure)
115         return true;
116      if (forwarded)
117         return false;
118      try {
119         return remoteAddr != null && InetAddress.getByName(remoteAddr).isLoopbackAddress();
120      } catch (@SuppressWarnings("unused") IOException e) {
121         return false;
122      }
123   }
124
125   /**
126    * Returns the key read at startup, or <jk>null</jk> if none is configured or the configuration could not be read.
127    *
128    * @return The configured key, or <jk>null</jk>.
129    */
130   protected String configuredKey() {
131      return key;
132   }
133
134   static boolean isAuthorized(String configured, String authorization, String xApiKey) {
135      if (configured == null || configured.isEmpty())
136         return false;
137      var expected = configured.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
138      var ok = false;
139      if (authorization != null && authorization.regionMatches(true, 0, BEARER, 0, BEARER.length()))
140         ok = matches(expected, authorization.substring(BEARER.length()).trim());
141      if (xApiKey != null)
142         ok |= matches(expected, xApiKey.trim());
143      return ok;
144   }
145
146   private static boolean matches(byte[] expected, String supplied) {
147      return MessageDigest.isEqual(expected, supplied.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
148   }
149}
